title.en: Aboriginal rights and the residential schools
title.fr: Les droits des Autochtones et les pensionnats

text.en: It is believed that the ancestors of Aboriginal peoples came here from Asia, many thousands of years ago.
text.fr: On croit que les ancêtres des peuples autochtones sont venus d'Asie, il y a plusieurs milliers d'années.

source.quote: The ancestors of Aboriginal peoples are believed to have migrated from Asia many thousands of years ago.

text.en: Aboriginal peoples had long been settled on this land when the first European explorers reached North America.
text.fr: Les peuples autochtones étaient installés sur ce territoire depuis longtemps quand les premiers explorateurs européens sont arrivés en Amérique du Nord.

source.quote: They were well established here long before explorers from Europe first came to North America.

text.en: The Canadian Constitution includes Aboriginal rights and treaty rights.
text.fr: La Constitution canadienne comprend les droits ancestraux des Autochtones et les droits issus de traités.

source.quote: Aboriginal and treaty rights are in the Canadian Constitution.

text.en: King George III's Royal Proclamation of 1763 was the first to guarantee the territorial rights of Aboriginal peoples. It also laid the ground for making treaties with the newcomers.
text.fr: La Proclamation royale de 1763, du roi George III, a été la première à garantir les droits territoriaux des peuples autochtones. Elle a aussi jeté les bases des traités à négocier avec les nouveaux arrivants.

source.quote: Territorial rights were first guaranteed through the Royal Proclamation of 1763 by King George III, and established the basis for negotiating treaties with the newcomers

text.en: The treaties made with the newcomers were not always fully kept.
text.fr: Les traités conclus avec les nouveaux arrivants n'ont pas toujours été pleinement respectés.

source.quote: treaties that were not always fully respected.

text.en: Starting in the 1800s and going on into the 1980s, the federal government put many Aboriginal children in residential schools.
text.fr: À partir des années 1800 et jusque dans les années 1980, le gouvernement fédéral a placé de nombreux enfants autochtones dans des pensionnats.

source.quote: From the 1800s until the 1980s, the federal government placed many Aboriginal children in residential schools

text.en: In the residential schools, Aboriginal languages and cultural practices were, for the most part, not allowed.
text.fr: Dans les pensionnats, les langues et les pratiques culturelles autochtones étaient, pour la plupart, interdites.

source.quote: Aboriginal languages and cultural practices were mostly prohibited.

text.en: In 2008, the Government of Canada made a formal apology to the people who had been students in the residential schools.
text.fr: En 2008, le gouvernement du Canada a présenté des excuses officielles aux personnes qui avaient été élèves des pensionnats.

source.quote: In 2008, Ottawa formally apologized to the former students.

text.en: Today, Aboriginal peoples have done important work in farming, in caring for the environment, in business and in the arts.
text.fr: Aujourd'hui, les peuples autochtones ont accompli des choses importantes en agriculture, en environnement, en affaires et dans les arts.

source.quote: have made significant achievements in agriculture, the environment, business and the arts.
